prefab.name: OpenClaw
prefab.description: Self-hosted AI assistant, reachable from its web interface and from chat apps (Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp).

gateway_token.help: Paste it in the web interface (Settings) to connect. Full access to the assistant: keep it secret.
gateway_token.label: Gateway token

anthropic_api_key.help: Optional. Other providers can be set up from the web interface.
anthropic_api_key.label: Anthropic API key

config.description: OpenClaw configuration (openclaw.json), also edited by the web interface. Listening, trusted proxy and site origin are rewritten on start.

list-devices.help: Browsers and apps waiting for approval, with their request id.
list-devices.label: List devices

approve-device.help: A new browser must be approved once before using the web interface ("pairing required").
approve-device.label: Approve a device
